name: Set Project Parameters
description: Sets project parameters, often of the project it is in, from records holding a parameter name and a value; all values are set in one request.
introductoryText:
Sets parameters of a project from the input: one record per parameter, with the parameter's name in one field and its new value in another. All the values go in one request, so either all are set or none.

**Setting up**

1. Give the project's address, ending in .iox. To change the parameters of this project, use its own address, for example `http://127.0.0.1:24679/Folder/Project.iox/`.
2. Choose the name field and the value field.

When a name appears twice, the later record's value is set. The user needs the *Project parameters access via APIs* permission. The **Set** output holds the records whose values were set.

Blocks that read a parameter use its new value the next time they run.

options.name: Iox_File_Url
options.title: Project address
options.description: The address of the project whose parameters to set, ending in .iox. On the same server, the internal address such as http://127.0.0.1:24679/Folder/Project.iox/ avoids the public address and its certificate. A report or workflow address of the project is cut back to the project.

options.name: username
options.title: Username
options.description: Optional. For a server that asks for sign-in with a list of users: sent with basic authentication, so use an https:// address unless it is the server's own 127.0.0.1 address. Leave empty when no sign-in is needed.

options.name: password
options.title: Password
options.description: Optional. The password for the username.

options.name: Params_Name
options.title: Name field
options.description: The field holding the names of the parameters to set.

options.name: Params_Value
options.title: Value field
options.description: The field holding the values to give them.

blockOutputs.label: Set
blockOutputs.tooltip: The records whose values were set: one per parameter (for a name given twice, the later record).
